title: Hom continuity for locally finitely presented integral module sheaves
statement: Let X be a scheme with noetherian underlying space, ℓ prime, E a finite normed extension of Q_ℓ, and P a locally finitely presented integral coefficient module on X. For every small filtered category I of universe u+1, every I-diagram N of cochain complexes over these modules that vanishes below one common termwise lower bound, and every integer n, the canonical additive shifted Hom colimit comparison from P[0] into N is an isomorphism. The cocone is the canonical colimit cocone of N.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.11(3), Lemma 6.8.12 and the proof of Lemma 6.3.14

proof.text: Choose the two-term locally finite free resolution F1→F0→P. Finite free Hom continuity gives homColimitProperty for F1[0] and F0[0] in every shift for the fixed diagram N.

The short exact sequence gives a distinguished single-sheaf triangle. Rotate it so the first and third terms are F0[0] and F1[0][1]. Shift stability and distinguished extension closure give homColimitProperty of P[0]. Evaluate at n; this is exactly the requested canonical colimit.desc.

lean.statement: theorem integral_lfp_hom_continuity (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X] (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E] (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj (CondensedRing.integralCoeff ℓ E) X)) (hP : IsLocallyFinitelyPresented (condensedRingObj (CondensedRing.integralCoeff ℓ E) X) P) {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (N : I ⥤ CochainComplex (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj (CondensedRing.integralCoeff ℓ E) X)) ℤ) (hN : ∃ a : ℤ, ∀ (i : I) (r : ℤ), r < a → IsZero ((N.obj i).X r)) (n : ℤ) : IsIso (colimit.desc _ ((condensedShiftedHom (CondensedRing.integralCoeff ℓ E) X ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj P) n).mapCocone (colimit.cocone N)))
